$comment: Known advertising / ad-tracking SDK and domain signatures. Used by src/test/no-ads.test.ts, scripts/verify-apk.mjs and the Android workflow. Matching is case-insensitive; '.' and '/' are interchangeable in package names.
$comment_permissions: 'permissions' are the only ones the app may request. 'allowedAppPermissions' are permissions the app defines for itself and that AndroidX adds automatically (e.g. androidx.core's signature-level receiver guard); they grant nothing to other apps and are not ad-related.
